ops:
separated, with \`#\` comments. pi-action installs npm packages in the same way, without lifecycle scripts, but it does not run their code. A package in \`extensions\` gives its skills too, so you do not have to write it in both inputs.

\`\`\`yaml
- uses: cv/pi-action@v2
  with:
    github_token: \${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    trust_project: true             # for .
